scenes.supernova_script:
Rahul says: You memorized 'A for Apple' in childhood, right?
Rahul says: But sadly, after years of school, you still freeze when it is time to actually speak a full sentence in English.

- Lands beat d (old methods failed).
- Names English immediately.
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text: A FOR APPLE, YEARS OF SCHOOL, STILL FREEZE, SPEAK A FULL SENTENCE IN ENGLISH.

scenes.supernova_script:
Rahul says: The truth is, without spoken English, you do not get the respect you truly deserve at work.
Rahul says: That is why you need Supernova AI.
Rahul says: It does not give everyone the same lesson—it analyzes your level and builds a personalized plan just for you.

scenes.supernova_script:

- Lands beat b (Privacy/No-judgment) as the core retention engine.

scenes.supernova_script:
Rahul says: The best part is that she explains the logic in your own language so you never feel lost.
Rahul says: You practice real-life scenarios like a job interview by actually speaking out loud.

- Lands beat e (Real-life scenarios - interview).
- Lands beat c (You speak).
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text: LOGIC IN YOUR LANGUAGE, REAL-LIFE SCENARIOS, JOB INTERVIEW, SPEAK OUT LOUD.

scenes.supernova_script:
Rahul says: Just give it fifteen minutes a day, and you will start seeing visible progress in your confidence within a month.
